proof_bundle: Inclusion proof bundle for leaves available in the last published Merkle root, with leaf hashes, indexes, proof paths, the Merkle root and signed card count. Not a grade.
receipts_batch: Historical measurement-card batch from published roots for a requested time window, capped at 200 leaves, with inclusion paths and carrying roots. Not payment or settlement receipts.
request_attestation: A card-v0 commission receipt for one named subject: content-addressed (sha256 of the canonical payload), Ed25519-signed by did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1 when that key answers at issue time (it also signs this 402's extensions["offer-receipt"] offer), else delivered with sig_ed25519 null and unsigned_reason; csoai.signer here says which before you pay. Plus up to 24 signed measurement cards for the subject; reserve_count reports the full match count. Payment never mints a MEASURED cell.
